note: Dade County GA has no county zoning per its joint comprehensive plans (2007, 2017). The only zoning-holding jurisdiction is the City of Trenton (Appendix A zoning ordinance, zoning map), but no public ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable zoning district layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or NWGRC/county/city sites. Only commercial vendors (Dynamo Spatial parcel shapefile, Zoneomics third-party map) carry Trenton zoning, neither a public queryable service.
